description: Corrects command-sign NAMES against the official DoT chart. Three are substantive: R105/R106 were carrying the R108/R109 names ('Turn Left'/'Turn Right') when the chart calls them 'Proceed left only'/'Proceed right only' — a different instruction; and R123 carried a fabricated '3500 kg' threshold when the chart says simply 'Goods vehicles only' (the GVM figure belongs to R124). Two are wording alignment (R111 'Pedal cycles only', R116 'Motor cycles only'). Stored MEANINGS were checked and are correct in each case — this is a naming defect, not a content one, but names travel into source_citation.

ops.why: Stored name 'Turn Left' does not match the official DoT chart, which lists 'R105 Proceed left only sign' in the Command signs block (resources/charts/RTSigns_charts.pdf). Names matter beyond display: they are pasted into questions' source_citation, so a wrong name propagates into the evidence trail. Found 2026-08-03 while drafting command-sign questions.
